title: Path of Exile 2 0.4.0 — The Last of the Druids: Druid, Fate of the Vaal, Abyss & What Still Applies in 0.5.4e
summary: 0.4.0 introduced the Druid class, Oracle and Shaman ascendancies, Talisman weapons, the Fate of the Vaal league and the buildable Atziri Temple, and moved Abyss into the core game. This page tracks what survived to 0.5.4e and which old guides are now outdated.
description: A returning-player history of Path of Exile 2 0.4.0 The Last of the Druids: every major system it added, the 0.4.0d/e/i follow-up fixes, and a current-applicability board showing what still works in client 0.5.4e versus what was changed or removed.
author: StratLore Editorial
imageAlt: Path of Exile 2 Druid in bear shapeshift form

sections.title: Historical context
sections.era: Path of Exile 2 Early Access — 0.4.0 (The Last of the Druids)
sections.baselineNote: This page documents a past client version. All 'current' statements below are measured against client 0.5.4e.

versions.summary: Druid class, Oracle/Shaman, Talisman, Fate of the Vaal league, Atziri Temple, Abyss core, 250+ passives, CPU optimizations.
Improved Temple room connection logic, death-retry flow, and map-state feedback for disconnected rooms.
Removed automatic Destabilisation, added explicit warnings before a room destabilises, tuned Architect pacing.
Fixed 'recently Shapeshifted' crit condition, Talisman weapon requirement checks, and several client crashes on console.

cards.detail: Druid, Oracle and Shaman are now base classes/ascendancies. Any pre-0.4.0 'best class' ranking is out of date.
Talisman weapons power Shapeshift builds. They do not behave like ordinary staves or sceptres.
Fate of the Vaal and the Atziri Temple survived but with the 0.4.0d/e connection and Destabilisation changes.
Abyss is no longer a temporary league; it appears in core maps. Old 'Abyss league only' guides are wrong.
CPU-side optimizations helped dense encounters, but later 0.5.x shader work changed the bottleneck profile.

rows.currentSummary: Druid, Oracle and Shaman remain selectable classes in 0.5.4e with their 0.4.0 identity intact.
rows.affectedContent: Bear Shaman Druid build, Fire Bear build

rows.currentSummary: Talisman remains the Shapeshift base weapon; the 0.4.0i crit-condition fix is still in effect.
0.4.0d/e rewrote connection and Destabilisation rules; later patches added further map feedback.
0.4.0e removed automatic Destabilisation; rooms now only destabilise after explicit warnings.
0.4.0 CPU work is real but the 0.5.x shader/Vulkan changes shifted where frame time is spent; measure on your own hardware.

changes.title: Druid class added
changes.detail: A nature-themed class built around Shapeshift forms (Bear, Spriggan, and others) and Primal Skills. Replaced the pre-0.4.0 'no Druid' state.

changes.title: Oracle and Shaman ascendancies
changes.detail: Two Druid-specific ascendancies: Oracle leans into ward/prophecy, Shaman into elemental and summons. Each has its own ascendancy node cluster.

changes.title: 35+ Supports and 8+ Lineage Supports
changes.detail: Druid shipped with a large support package including Lineage Supports that only socket into Primal Skills.

changes.title: Talisman weapons
changes.detail: A new weapon base that enables Shapeshift transforms. Not a reskin of staves — it has unique requirements checked by the client.

changes.title: Fate of the Vaal league
changes.detail: A league where Beacons, Energy and room placement build a multi-room Atziri Temple you can fight through.

changes.title: Abyss promoted to core
changes.detail: Abyss no longer expires as a league; Abyss nodes appear in core maps, changing old 'league-only' farming routes.

changes.title: CPU-side performance pass
changes.detail: Optimizations for dense monster counts and projectile processing. Later 0.5.x shader work changed the bottleneck.

changes.title: 0.4.0i Shapeshift crit condition
changes.detail: Fixed the 'recently Shapeshifted' crit condition so it triggers reliably after leaving a form.

rows.thenText: Before 0.4.0 there was no Druid; nature fantasy was covered only by generic spells.
rows.nowText: Druid is a base class with Oracle and Shaman; nature builds have a dedicated tree.

rows.thenText: 0.4.0 launch had fragile room connections and automatic Destabilisation that could brick a run.
rows.nowText: 0.4.0d/e fixed connections and removed auto-Destabilisation; rooms warn before destabilising.

rows.thenText: Abyss was a temporary league mechanic available only during its league.
rows.nowText: Abyss is core: Abyss nodes appear in regular maps and old league-only routes are gone.

rows.thenText: 0.4.0 claimed CPU-side gains as the main win for dense fights.
rows.nowText: 0.5.x shader/Vulkan work changed where time is spent; re-benchmark on 0.5.4e.

bosses.name: Atziri, the Red Queen
bosses.detail: Final boss of the rebuilt Temple. Her mirror-split and charge patterns are unchanged in identity but the arena access rules changed via 0.4.0d.
bosses.action: Update Temple-access guides to the post-0.4.0d connection rules.

bosses.name: The Architect
bosses.detail: Builds and defends the Temple rooms. 0.4.0e tuned its pacing after Destabilisation was removed.
bosses.action: Treat Architect as a pacing, not a bricking, threat in current guides.

bosses.name: Vaal-themed rares
bosses.detail: Fate of the Vaal introduced Vaal-touched monsters with corrupting modifiers in Temple rooms.
bosses.action: Map them under Endgame/Temple content, not a separate league.

items.title: Talisman
items.detail: The Shapeshift weapon base. Requires a Druid-form build to use its transform affixes effectively.

items.title: Orb of Sacrifice
items.detail: Used in Temple crafting and Vaal-corruption adjacent workflows introduced with Fate of the Vaal.

items.title: Vaal Orb
items.detail: Promoted alongside the Vaal storyline; its corrupting role is consistent with pre-0.4.0 behaviour.

items.label: Re-learn the class roster
items.detail: Druid, Oracle and Shaman did not exist before 0.4.0. Old 'top classes' lists are obsolete; start from the current class index.

items.label: Trust Temple guides only post-0.4.0d/e
items.detail: Any video or written guide from 0.4.0 launch week describes room connections and Destabilisation that no longer exist.

items.label: Stop treating Abyss as league-only
items.detail: Abyss is core now; farming routes that assumed a separate league are wrong.

items.label: Re-benchmark performance
items.detail: 0.4.0 CPU gains do not describe 0.5.x shader behaviour; do not repeat old FPS claims.

items.label: Check Talisman weapon rules
items.detail: Talisman is a transform weapon, not a staff reskin; verify weapon requirements before copying old layouts.

reports.context: Players reported Temple runs where rooms disconnected or destabilised mid-fight.
reports.quote: Half my Temple was unreachable and then the whole thing destabilised with no warning.
reports.analysis: This matches the 0.4.0 launch connection/Destabilisation behaviour. 0.4.0d fixed connections and 0.4.0e removed auto-Destabilisation, so current runs should not see this.

reports.source: Forum thread on Druid Shapeshift crits (0.4.0–0.4.0i)
reports.context: Bear builds reported 'recently Shapeshifted' crits not proccing after leaving form.
reports.quote: My crit condition never triggers after I un-bear; feels broken.
reports.analysis: Confirmed by 0.4.0i patch notes as a fixed bug. On 0.5.4e the condition works as described, so old complaints no longer apply.

reports.context: Viewers confused that Abyss appeared outside its league season.
reports.quote: Why am I getting Abyss in a normal map?
reports.analysis: Correct behaviour: 0.4.0 promoted Abyss to core. Guides that say 'Abyss only during its league' are outdated.
